objective: Preallocate FBTree bulk-load outer buffers from iterator and fanout size hints.

tasks.title: Preallocate FBTree bulk-load buffers
tasks.result: FBTree bulk loading now reserves leaf, arena, and next-level buffers from iterator size hints and the fixed fanout.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The capacity estimate uses the iterator upper size hint when present, otherwise the lower bound.
The change preserves bulk-load leaf flush order, leaf linking, inner node fanout, get, and scan behavior.
